name: Sonnet
source:
"Play..." 

 An elf. Tender and gentle. She likes to play. She doesn't understand difficult things, but she likes to play so she wants [url=/c730]Yuu[/url] to protect her. 

 Battle quote - "Here I go..."
[Edited from [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/]Alice Soft wiki[/url]]
